data: Which senator is represented by a single blue dot located at the far left of the figure?

The question asks which senator is represented by a single blue dot located at the far left of the figure. From the caption, we know that Democrats are represented by blue circles and Republicans by red crosses. The far left of the figure corresponds to the lowest value on the x-axis, approximately -0.4. 

Looking at the figure, there is one blue dot located at the far left, and it is labeled as Bernie Sanders (I-VT). Therefore, the senator represented by the single blue dot at the far left of the figure is Bernie Sanders.
